porcelain.role: Primary background. Warm off-white; the page colour and the on-ink text colour.

porcelain-2.role: Secondary surface: cards, media frames, the studio cyclorama.

ink.role: Primary dark. Dark sections, the capsule header on hover, buttons, the app icon background.

ink-2.role: Secondary dark surface inside ink sections.

text.role: Body and headline text on porcelain.

text-2.role: Secondary text: ledes, captions, the 'Cosmetic Dentistry' descriptor.

on-ink.role: Text on ink (same value as porcelain).

mark-gold.role: The accent. The period in the wordmark, the dot in the monogram, hairline shine on the CTA, small highlights. Never a fill for large areas.

gold-text.role: Gold for small type on light backgrounds (5:1 on porcelain). Use instead of mark-gold whenever gold has to be read.

extended.hero-gradient: Dark cinematic grade over footage: ink at ~0.94 alpha on the copy side fading to ~0.5 across the frame.
extended.gum-pink (3D model only): #F0B4AE sheen on the gum material; not a brand colour.
extended.payment-slider field: Soft positive drift of mint → butter → apricot behind the monthly number; decorative only.

proportions: Porcelain ~70%, ink ~25%, gold under 2% of any composition. Gold is punctuation, not a colour field.
